hero.headline: Come as You Are. Stay for the People.
hero.subheadline: Riverbend Commons is a church and community hub on the east side. Sunday gatherings, weekday groups, and a Foundations workshop twice a year.
hero.trust_line: Meeting on the east side since 2014

schedule.headline: When We Meet
schedule.subheadline: Three regular gatherings every week. Show up to any of them, no signup needed.

items.title: Sunday Worship
items.desc: Full service with music and teaching. Childcare at both services.

items.title: Wednesday Bible Study
items.desc: Verse-by-verse study in the fellowship hall. All ages welcome.

items.title: Youth Night
items.desc: Grades 6 through 12. Games, food, and a short talk.

schedule#2.headline: Workshop Schedule
schedule#2.subheadline: Two days, one room, no fluff. Here is exactly how the weekend runs.

items.title: Why Community Still Matters
items.speaker: Pastor Dana Whitfield
items.desc: Where the weekend is headed and why we built this workshop in the first place.

items.title: Reading Scripture Together
items.speaker: Dr. Samuel Obi
items.desc: A simple method for reading in groups that keeps everyone in the conversation.

items.title: Serving Your Neighborhood
items.speaker: James Holt
items.desc: Practical ways to plug into local outreach without burning out.

steps.headline: What You Will Work Through
steps.subheadline: The workshop follows our four-module Foundations course. Each module stands on its own, so missing one is not a dealbreaker.

items.title: Foundations of Faith
items.desc: The core story of scripture and why it still holds up. No prior background assumed.

items.title: Habits That Hold
items.desc: Prayer, reading, and rest as repeatable weekly habits instead of guilt trips.

items.title: Community and Belonging
items.desc: Why faith was never meant to be a solo project, and how to find your people here.

items.title: Serving Where You Are
items.desc: Matching what you are good at with what the neighborhood actually needs.

pricing.headline: Support the Work
pricing.subheadline: Everything we run, from youth night to the food pantry, is funded by people who call this place home.

plans.name: Neighbor
plans.description: Stocks the food pantry shelf for one family for a week.

plans.name: Supporter
plans.description: Covers materials and meals for one student through a full youth night season.

plans.name: Builder
plans.description: Funds a Foundations workshop seat, including the course workbook, for someone who could not otherwise attend.

pricing.trust_line: Riverbend Commons is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Every gift is tax-deductible.

cta_final.headline: New Here? Start This Sunday
cta_final.description: Pick a service, come ten minutes early, and someone at the door will walk you through the rest.

brand.name: Riverbend Commons
brand.description: A church and community hub on the east side. Sunday gatherings, weekday groups, and room at the table for whoever shows up.
